manifest.name: @local/dsh-amadeus-workbench
manifest.description: Amadeus-inspired launch workbench for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

readme.text:
[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

An unofficial Amadeus-inspired launch panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. The companion [Amadeus Skin](https://github.com/Veagau/dsh-amadeus-skin) is optional.

- Crimson terminal scene, fan art, fictional worldline numbers and system log. These are decorative, not system telemetry.
- Local clock and shortcuts to conversations, plugins and scheduled tasks. Opening a conversation does not send a message.
- English and Chinese interfaces, animation pause and support for reduced-motion preferences.
- No external asset requests or changes to models, prompts, permissions or assistant personality. Voice, Live2D and character memory are not included.
Requires DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI and plugin manager. Compatibility depends on your DSH version; verify it in your environment.

If Amadeus Workbench is listed in a plugin market configured in DSH, find it there and install it using the market's install action. This is conditional on a listing being available; it is not a claim that the bundle is currently listed.

1. Clone or download and extract this repository to a local directory.
2. Ask the DSH assistant to call `plugin_manager` with `action: "install_bundle"` and `target` set to the **absolute path of the bundle directory** (the directory containing `package.json`), not a file or a relative path. For example, use `C:\path\to\dsh-amadeus-workbench` on Windows or `/path/to/dsh-amadeus-workbench` on macOS/Linux.
3. Check the installation result for warnings and whether changes were applied. Restart DSH if required, then select the Amadeus icon in the sidebar.

Installation affects all sessions in the current profile, not other profiles. A restart may be needed before changes take effect; follow the installation result. Keep the source directory in place for a linked local installation. Disable or uninstall the bundle to remove the workbench.

Requires Node.js. After editing `client.source.js`:

```sh
npm run build
npm test
```

The build embeds local images in `client.js`. Tests use mocked React/DSH contracts; they are not browser or visual acceptance tests. Verify UI compatibility with your DSH version.

Project-authored code is licensed under [MIT](LICENSE); this does not grant rights to third-party marks, characters or artwork. The gold logo comes from [Yink/Amadeus](https://github.com/Yink/Amadeus); its official provenance and redistribution permission are unverified. This project is unofficial and unaffiliated. Review [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md) and assess rights before use or redistribution.

[English](README.md)

非官方的 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面启动工作台，灵感来自 Amadeus。[Amadeus Skin](https://github.com/Veagau/dsh-amadeus-skin) 可选，可独立使用。

- 深红终端场景、角色同人立绘、世界线数字和系统日志；后两者仅作装饰，并非实际系统遥测。
- 本地时钟，以及对话、插件和定时任务快捷入口；进入对话不会发送消息。
- 中英文界面、暂停动效及系统减少动态效果偏好支持。
- 不请求外部素材，不修改模型、提示词、权限或助手人格；不包含语音、Live2D 或角色记忆。
需要带 Web UI 和插件管理功能的 DeepSeek Harness。兼容性取决于 DSH 版本，请在自己的环境中验证。
如果 Amadeus Workbench 已在 DSH 配置的插件市场中上架，可在市场中找到它并使用安装操作。此步骤以上架可用为前提，并不表示目前已经上架。

1. 克隆本仓库，或下载并解压到本地目录。
2. 请 DSH 助手调用 `plugin_manager`，设置 `action: "install_bundle"`，并将 `target` 设为 **bundle 目录的绝对路径**（包含 `package.json` 的目录），不要填写文件路径或相对路径。例如 Windows 使用 `C:\path\to\dsh-amadeus-workbench`，macOS/Linux 使用 `/path/to/dsh-amadeus-workbench`。
3. 查看安装结果中的警告和变更是否已应用；如有需要，重启 DSH，然后在侧栏选择 Amadeus 图标。

安装影响当前 profile 的所有会话，不影响其他 profile。变更可能需要重启才能生效，请以安装结果为准。链接安装时请保留源码目录；禁用或卸载该 bundle 即可移除工作台。

需要 Node.js。修改 `client.source.js` 后运行：

```sh
npm run build
npm test
```

构建会将本地图片嵌入 `client.js`。测试使用模拟的 React/DSH 契约，不等同于浏览器或视觉验收测试；请自行验证与所用 DSH 版本的界面兼容性。
项目自行编写的代码以 [MIT](LICENSE) 许可；该许可不授予第三方标识、角色或美术素材的权利。金色徽标来自 [Yink/Amadeus](https://github.com/Yink/Amadeus)，其官方来源及再分发授权尚未核实。本项目为非官方作品，与原作及权利人无官方关联。使用或再分发前请查阅 [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md) 并自行核实相关权利。
